rule: median craft score within 1 of the exemplar, and a memorable moment named by most critics, in every trial

per.memorable: the scan line sweeping the forecast and turning the windy hours amber
the scan line turning wind bars amber as it passes

corrections.problem: button still says 'Checking' for about 1.7s after the header announces '2 windows found'
corrections.change: switch the button back to 'Find windows' in the same frame the header count lands, or 0.1s after it
corrections.keep: the header count rolling in place

corrections.problem: the climax (leave 08:30, arrive 10:10, back 12:30, home 14:10) is on screen only about 1.5s before the clip ends
corrections.change: bring the plan in about 0.5s after the windows land and hold it at least 2.5s with nothing else moving
corrections.keep: the plan appearing in place under the Out and Back rows

corrections.problem: a wide pink gradient band washes over tide, stream and wind rows, competing with the amber bars it is revealing
corrections.change: reduce to a 1px line with no band, so the bars changing color are the only thing that draws the eye
corrections.keep: left to right order and roughly 1.2s duration

corrections.problem: the cursor sits on the button and the press reads as a color flip with no pressed state
corrections.change: add a 100ms pressed scale (0.97) before the label changes
corrections.keep: the cursor arriving before the scan starts

per.memorable: the wind bars turning amber as the scan line passes

corrections.problem: old and new labels are drawn on top of each other for a frame or two
corrections.change: slide the old label out before the new one enters (or roll it vertically inside a clipped box), no overlap
corrections.keep: the press timing right after the cursor lands

corrections.problem: a 1.5s full-width sweep with a pink wash competes with the bars it is judging
corrections.change: shorten to about 0.8s with an ease-out and drop the wash, let the amber bars carry the result
corrections.keep: the left-to-right order so the windows resolve in time order

corrections.problem: the answer appears as small corner text while attention is on the chart
corrections.change: land the status change in the same beat as the last bar turning amber and give it a brief emphasis
corrections.keep: the in-place status swap

corrections.problem: the plan arrives while the eye is still on the bars and the clip ends 1.5s later
corrections.change: hold the plan at least 2.5s with nothing else moving
corrections.keep: the plan as the final state

per.memorable: the scan line turning the windy hours amber

corrections.problem: the button state contradicts the '2 windows found' header for 1.5s
corrections.change: flip the button back to 'Find windows' within 100ms of the last row filling
corrections.keep: the left-to-right sweep and the rows filling as it passes

corrections.where: A 2.2s, header, wind bars, Out and Back rows
corrections.problem: header, bars and both row labels all change in the same 200ms, so nothing owns the screen
corrections.change: order it: bars first, rows 100ms later, header count last
corrections.keep: the amber color of the windy hours

corrections.problem: old and new labels overlap in a crossfade for a frame or two
corrections.change: roll the new label up into place and fade the old one out before it enters
corrections.keep: the pink time-window chip on the timeline

corrections.problem: the payoff arrives last and smallest at the bottom of the card
corrections.change: hold the plan at least 2.5s and give it a single short emphasis, such as the times rolling in
corrections.keep: the 4-column plan layout

per.memorable: wind bars turning amber behind the scan line

corrections.problem: button reads 'Checking' while the header already reports '2 windows found'
corrections.change: resolve the button state in the same frame as the header count
corrections.keep: the count changing in place in the header

corrections.problem: about 8s of nothing after a 3s story; the pacing is front loaded and the climax gets no build
corrections.change: slow the sweep to about 1.6s, land windows, wait 0.6s, then reveal the plan, and loop after a 3s hold
corrections.keep: the order: press, scan, windows, plan

corrections.problem: a broad pink wash moves across every row at once and decorates rather than informs
corrections.change: replace with a thin line and let only the amber bars and the Out and Back blocks change
corrections.keep: left to right direction

corrections.where: A 2.0s to 2.5s, Out and Back blocks
corrections.problem: both outlined windows appear while the scan is still running, so two things own the screen
corrections.change: draw the Out window when the scan passes it and the Back window 0.1s after the scan finishes
corrections.keep: the pink outline treatment of the windows

per.memorable: the bars turning amber behind the sweep

corrections.where: A 0.9s to 2.5s, scan line and pink wash
corrections.problem: the sweep is slow and decorative and the pink wash lowers contrast on the chart labels
corrections.change: cut the sweep to about 0.8s, no wash, ease out at the right edge
corrections.keep: bars turning amber as the line passes them

corrections.where: A 3.6s to 4.0s, proposed plan rows and button
corrections.problem: the plan rows appear while the button label switches back to Find windows
corrections.change: settle the button first, then reveal the plan 0.1s later as its own beat
corrections.keep: the plan times 08:30, 10:10, 12:30, 14:10 as the final read

corrections.where: A 2.5s, '2 windows found' and Leave rows
corrections.problem: the answer lives in small text at the card edges, easy to miss
corrections.change: stagger Out and Back leave rows about 0.1s apart and let the windows on the strips pulse once
corrections.keep: the in-place swaps from 'Not checked'

corrections.problem: the label crossfade shows two labels at once
corrections.change: roll the label in a clipped box
corrections.keep: press timing

per.memorable: the return window shrinking and its cut-off piece fading out as hatching

corrections.where: A 3.9s to 4.1s, notification and forecast chip
corrections.problem: the new notification and the forecast chip highlight start together, so the eye splits
corrections.change: let the notification land first, then start the chip 150ms later as its consequence
corrections.keep: the roll of 18:00 to 21:00 and 13:45 to 13:20

corrections.problem: the 'Plan saved' card is three lines and reads for about 2.6s before it is replaced
corrections.change: hold it 3.5s or cut it to one line
corrections.keep: the notification sliding in at the card's lower right

corrections.problem: the whole card fades through blank, a visible cut
corrections.change: reverse the update in place or hold on the final state
corrections.keep: the 7s hold of the final state

per.memorable: the back window trimming 25 minutes with a hatched sliver as the forecast time turns amber

corrections.problem: the hatched 25 minute sliver fades out within about 0.6s, so the change is unreadable after the fact
corrections.change: keep the trimmed sliver hatched (in the muted amber) for the rest of the hold
corrections.keep: the box shrinking from the right edge in place

corrections.problem: the new notification and four card values all change within 0.6s at opposite corners, so nothing owns the screen
corrections.change: let the notification land first and hold 1.0s, then run the card cascade (header, time, box, row) at 0.1s offsets
corrections.keep: the 0.1s offsets inside the card cascade

corrections.problem: old toast fades out before the new one fades in, leaving an empty slot
corrections.change: slide the new toast in over the old one, or replace its contents in place
corrections.keep: the toast position bottom right

corrections.problem: two lines of dense body text held about 2.4s, short for reading aloud
corrections.change: hold at least 3.5s or cut the body to one line
corrections.keep: the plain, specific wording

per.memorable: the window bar trimming 25 minutes off its end with a hatched slice

corrections.where: A 1.4s to 3.8s, 'Plan saved for Saturday' notification
corrections.problem: about 25 words with four times are held 2.4s, not readable aloud
corrections.change: hold it 5s or shorten it to 'Plan saved. Out 07:33, back 11:10.'
corrections.keep: its gentle fade and rise entrance

corrections.problem: the new notification arrives before the card shows the change, so the text explains something not yet visible
corrections.change: move the card first (badge, then end time, then bar trim), then bring the notification 0.2s after the bar settles
corrections.keep: the 0.1s offsets between badge, end time and 15:00 row

corrections.where: A 4.3s, hatched trim on the window bar
corrections.problem: the trimmed slice is a few pixels wide and is the real news
corrections.change: animate the bar's right edge shrinking with an ease-out over about 0.4s and keep the hatched slice visible for a second
corrections.keep: the amber accent on changed values

corrections.problem: the whole card fades to blank and pops back
corrections.change: reset by crossfading only the changed values back, or hold the end state
corrections.keep: the 7s hold on the final state

corrections.problem: the pastel gradient competes with a calm card
corrections.change: use a flat neutral background
corrections.keep: the card's soft shadow

per.memorable: the line drawing itself across the Solent while the clock ticks

corrections.problem: a frame where the map tints wash to white
corrections.change: fix the render so the map stays solid through every frame
corrections.keep: the muted chart palette

corrections.problem: leg speed changes before the waypoint label does, so the readout disagrees with the map
corrections.change: change label, time and speed together on arrival, label first by about 100ms
corrections.keep: the live counting of time and distance

corrections.where: A each waypoint arrival, the moving dot
corrections.problem: the dot moves at constant speed and stops dead
corrections.change: ease out over the last 150ms into each waypoint
corrections.keep: the pause length at each waypoint

corrections.problem: the payoff gets less hold than the intermediate waypoints
corrections.change: hold the arrival at least 3s with the total time emphasized
corrections.keep: the dashed preview line ahead of the drawn route

per.memorable: the dot pausing at each waypoint while the readout settles

corrections.problem: one frame flash where the map tiles wash white
corrections.change: preload or keep the map layer static so it never rerenders during the move
corrections.keep: the route and labels

corrections.problem: leg speed changes to 6.4 kn before the waypoint label changes from Jack in the Basket to Hamstead Ledge, so the readout contradicts itself
corrections.change: update label, time and leg speed together on arrival, label first and numbers 0.1s after
corrections.keep: the rolling digit transitions

corrections.problem: time and distance tick every frame while the dot moves, so the eye is split between map and footer
corrections.change: let the dot move alone and roll the numbers only when it arrives at each waypoint
corrections.keep: the pauses of about 1.5s at waypoints

corrections.problem: arrival at Cowes is the climax but gets the same treatment as every other waypoint and only about 2s of hold
corrections.change: give arrival a distinct landing (dot settles with a slight overshoot, 'Arrive Cowes 10:10' emphasized) and hold 3s
corrections.keep: the full route line staying drawn

per.memorable: the route line drawing itself across the Solent

corrections.problem: the land washes to blurry white for a frame, a visible glitch
corrections.change: fix the tile or layer repaint so the map never redraws during the animation
corrections.keep: the map art and labels

corrections.where: A 3.4s to 4.0s, Leg speed and place readouts
corrections.problem: speed switches to the next leg while the place label still names the previous waypoint
corrections.change: update place, time and speed together the moment the marker reaches the waypoint, 0.1s apart left to right
corrections.keep: the pause at each waypoint

corrections.where: A 0.5s to 9.9s, clock and distance readouts
corrections.problem: numbers tick every frame while the marker moves, unreadable and busy
corrections.change: freeze readouts during travel and roll them to the new value at each waypoint, or tick in larger steps
corrections.keep: the monotonic distance values

corrections.problem: the climax is the same as every other waypoint and the speed updates late
corrections.change: ease the marker into Cowes, give the destination a single emphasis, and hold 'Arrive Cowes 10:10' at least 2.5s
corrections.keep: the solid route line replacing the dashed plan
